module.name: AWS EKS High-Performance Node Group
module.description: Creates dedicated high-performance EKS node group with optimized instance types (c5n, c6i) for BNK Gateway traffic management workloads.

required.reason: Requires IAM roles and SSH key for node configuration
Requires EKS cluster for node group attachment

required.name: subnet_ids
required.description: Private subnet IDs for node placement

required.name: vpc_security_group_id
required.description: Security group ID for cluster communication

required.name: nodegroup_role_arn
required.description: ARN of the IAM role for node groups

required.name: key_pair_name
required.description: Name of the SSH key pair for node access

required.name: nodegroup_role_name
required.description: Name of the nodegroup IAM role from security module

required.name: ecr_registry
required.description: ECR registry URL for container images (e.g., 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com)

optional.name: instance_types
optional.description: EC2 instance types for high-performance nodes

optional.name: f5_bnk_enabled
optional.description: Enable F5 BNK (BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes) specific configurations including TMM node labels and SR-IOV device plugin

optional.name: tmm_node_count
optional.description: Number of nodes to dedicate for TMM (tainted with dpu=true:NoSchedule and labeled app=f5-tmm). Remaining nodes stay untainted for BNK control plane pods.

optional.name: enable_multus
optional.description: Enable Multus CNI for multiple network interfaces

key_outputs.name: nodegroup_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the high-performance node group

key_outputs.name: nodegroup_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the high-performance node group

key_outputs.name: nodegroup_status
key_outputs.description: Status of the node group deployment

key_outputs.name: f5_bnk_readiness
key_outputs.description: Infrastructure readiness status for F5 BNK installation

key_outputs.name: summary
key_outputs.description: Summary of high-performance nodes configuration including TMM node topology
